cases.ruling: L4 approved citrolabs/ego-browser for the existing browser-control generic; approved at 2★.
cases.name: Low-level browser control through browser protocols
cases.description: Operate a browser through CDP to manipulate DOM, cookies, network traffic and user interactions without a high-level automation wrapper.

cases.ruling: Issue reports context-mode retrieved context-compression at 0.529 and memory-manage at 0.471; it asks for evaluation and does not adjudicate a target.
cases.name: Context-mode externalized context retrieval
cases.description: Reduce agent prompt load by storing conversation context externally and retrieving relevant portions as needed.

cases.ruling: Regression probe derived from the issue's explicit human L4 override: direct low-level browser control maps to browser-control, not the broader browser-automation label.
cases.name: Direct browser protocol control
cases.description: Use CDP directly to inspect and modify browser state, cookies, DOM and network requests; does not describe high-level workflow automation.

cases.ruling: RFC asks whether product-specific skills should be rejected, dependency-declared, warned, or tiered; no option is selected.
cases.name: Product-specific operational procedure
cases.description: Operate a named product's CLI and service-specific database using product-specific commands and assumptions.

cases.ruling: Regression probe: distinguish bad-faith squatters from legitimate self-hosted, prototype, conceptual and installable:false early-stage skills; do not infer purge from thin packaging alone.
cases.name: Early-stage self-hosted agent practice
cases.description: A prototype skill authored for an internal or self-hosted workflow that may be useful despite limited packaging, evidence or public installability.

cases.ruling: Regression probe: a product command/API reference without credit to the actual maker is an attribution/generalizability review concern; the issue's five-instance detector scope is not a mapping adjudication.
cases.name: Third-party tool command reference
cases.description: A skill that wraps one named external product's commands and API, without explaining a product-independent transferable capability or crediting its maintainer.

cases.ruling: Issue proposes disagreement and outcome sensors as observations; explicitly says disagreement is not authority and must not auto-mutate canonical curation.
cases.name: Independent semantic curation review
cases.description: Compare an independent curator's proposed mapping and disposition with a primary curation decision, preserving disagreements for human review.

cases.ruling: Synthetic regression probe for basic shape mapping: selective token pruning and prompt minimization maps to context-compression.
cases.name: Selective token pruning and prompt compaction
cases.description: Reduces context window consumption by identifying and removing redundant or low-information tokens from LLM prompts prior to model forward pass.

cases.ruling: Synthetic regression probe for fusion shape mapping: composite multi-session dialogue indexing and cross-turn retrieval maps to memory-manage.
cases.name: Cross-turn conversational state and long-term dialogue index
cases.description: Maintains structured dialogue history across distinct agent sessions, storing chat interactions in an indexed external store and recalling relevant past turns.

cases.ruling: Synthetic regression probe: raw devtools wire protocol control without wrapper libraries maps to browser-control.
cases.name: Low-level Chrome DevTools wire protocol driver
cases.description: Controls a remote or local headless browser via raw CDP websocket messages to capture screenshots, set session cookies, and read network request streams without playwright or selenium.

cases.ruling: Synthetic regression probe for router shape: request intent classification and sub-agent dispatch maps to route-intent.
cases.name: Natural language task classifier and executor dispatcher
cases.description: Parses incoming user instructions, evaluates operational intent, and routes the request to the matching specialized sub-agent or tool implementation.

cases.ruling: Synthetic regression probe for package shape: an omnibus bundle of unrelated dev utilities is an artifact package, not an individual capability.
cases.name: Multi-tool developer utility bundle
cases.description: An omnibus distribution containing unrelated developer automation scripts, git branch cleanup utilities, Docker build scripts, and local environment lint helpers packaged into a single repository.

cases.ruling: Synthetic regression probe for orthogonal no-match: quantum circuit transpilation has no canonical generic in the current catalog.
cases.name: Adiabatic quantum annealing Ising model mapper
cases.description: Translates polynomial unconstrained binary optimization problems into graph minor embeddings for execution on superconducting quantum annealer chipsets.

cases.ruling: Synthetic regression probe for orthogonal no-match: hardware description language place-and-route has no canonical generic in the catalog.
cases.name: Register-transfer level Verilog netlist synthesis
cases.description: Performs logic synthesis, technology mapping, place-and-route, and timing closure on Verilog hardware descriptions to produce FPGA bitstreams.
